title: How Timelock & Governance Execution Works
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Token holder] --> B[Submit proposal]
    B --> C{Proposal-creation delay}
    C --> D[Voting period opens]
    D --> E[Cast vote / castVoteBySig]
    E --> F{Quorum vs snapshot supply}
    F -->|Passed| G[Queue in timelock]
    F -->|Failed| H[Defeated]
    subgraph TL[Timelock machinery]
        G --> I{Delay elapsed?}
        I -->|No| J[Wait]
        J --> I
        I -->|Yes| K[execute via msg.sender == timelock]
    end
    K --> L[Apply param / upgrade / treasury move]

title: Flash-Loan Governance Takeover
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Attacker] --> B[Pre-stage malicious proposal]
    B --> C{Creation delay matures}
    C --> D[Open single transaction]
    subgraph ATK[One block, one tx]
        D --> E[Flash loan governance tokens]
        E --> F[Deposit to inflate voting power]
        F --> G{Voting power read live?}
        G -->|Yes| H[vote on malicious bip]
        H --> I{Execution delay enforced?}
        I -->|No timelock| J[emergencyCommit same tx]
        J --> K[Drain treasury / seize control]
        K --> L[Withdraw and repay flash loan]
    end
    G -->|Delegate to slave| H
    L --> M[Beanstalk $181M, Fortress, Atlantis]

title: Defense Pattern
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Proposal submitted] --> B[Snapshot getPastVotes at past block]
    B --> C[Quorum vs getPastTotalSupply]
    C --> D{Voting power held over time?}
    D -->|Flash-acquired| E[Reject: no live balance read]
    D -->|Genuine| F[Lock delegated AND direct weight]
    F --> G[Queue with mandatory timelock]
    subgraph TL[Hardened timelock]
        G --> H{Delay units = blocks/seconds correct}
        H --> I[Enforce min delay before execute]
        I --> J{msg.sender == timelock}
        J -->|No| K[Revert]
        J -->|Yes| L[nonReentrant single-use execute]
    end
    subgraph SIG[Signature hygiene]
        M[nonce + deadline]
        N[block.chainid in domain separator]
        O[hash all semantic flags]
    end
    L --> P[Execute approved payload]
    SIG --> P
